snapshot_uses_final_balance.meaning: Reward share is calculated from veTRUST balance at the single final timestamp of an epoch

utilization_duration_blind.meaning: Personal utilization ratio is computed exclusively from MultiVault activity deltas between epochs, ignoring lock duration within an epoch

attacker_prior_zero.meaning: Attacker held zero veTRUST position through epochs 0 to N-1 before epoch N

attacker_ve_trust_balance.meaning: Attacker's veTRUST balance included in the epoch N-end reward snapshot

lock_amount.meaning: Amount of TRUST locked by attacker in the final second of epoch N

max_time.meaning: Maximum lock duration used in veTRUST weight computation

epoch_length.meaning: Duration of one epoch in seconds (1,209,600)

assumptions: The attack is costless beyond the lock deposit (returned at unlock), repeatable every epoch, and scales linearly with stake size.
Whether the lock can be created in the exact final second/block before the snapshot is asserted but not demonstrated on-chain.
Authorization model of the lock/reward functions is not described.

unresolved.description: Exact unlockTime chosen by attacker in the final second is not specified; the relation uses max_time minus epoch_length as a proxy for it, so the 99.999% weight bound is symbolic.
No numeric reward amount or dilution value is given, so the honest-dilution economic consequence cannot be expressed as a numeric relation without inventing quantities.

limitations: Impact impact_honest_dilution is deferred; only impact_full_weight_for_second is formalized in this single core claim.
The 99.999% figure relies on unlockTime − epochEnd ≈ MAXTIME, which is not numerically specified in the report.
No actual executed transaction is shown; the scenario is described as a potential attack flow.
Authorization/permissionless access of lock and reward functions is not independently established.
